process.title: Discovery & Brief
process.subtitle: Understanding your lifestyle, vision & space
process.description: We begin with a detailed conversation about how you plan to use the space, your aesthetic preferences, budget, site measurements, and timeline requirements.

process.title: Space Planning & Layout
process.subtitle: Circulation, zoning & functional layout

process.title: Material & Concept Direction
process.subtitle: Textures, color palettes & finishes
process.description: Curating a harmonious palette of timber, stone, metal, textiles, and lighting fixtures tailored specifically to create a warm, calm, and sophisticated ambience.

process.title: 3D Visualization & Modeling
process.subtitle: High-resolution renders before execution
process.description: Translating 2D plans and material choices into photorealistic 3D renders so you can clearly visualize the finished atmosphere from every perspective.

process.title: Documentation & Execution
process.subtitle: Production drawings & site handoff
process.description: Finalizing clear technical drawings, elevations, material specifications, and vendor guidelines to ensure flawless on-site execution.

faqs.question: What kind of projects do you take?
faqs.answer: Residential interiors, selected commercial spaces, space planning, 3D visualization and drafting support.

faqs.question: Can I hire you only for 3D renders?
faqs.answer: Yes. Visualization can be booked as a standalone service when the required inputs and scope are clear.

faqs.question: How do project prices work?
faqs.answer: The website shows starting prices for common services. Final pricing depends on scope, area, number of views, complexity, revisions and timeline.

faqs.question: Do you work with architects and studios?
faqs.answer: Yes. Project-based collaboration and visualization/drafting support are available for creative teams and studios.

faqs.question: How do I start a project?
faqs.answer: Send a project brief through the Hire Me or Contact page. The scope, deliverables, timeline and quote can then be discussed before work begins.
